status_semantics: No field named status. This record is written BEFORE any sampled value is viewed, as required by the controller order.
purpose: To fix, in advance, how observing runs are delimited and how within-run declination constancy is tested, so that neither can be chosen after seeing the values.

population.definition: The complete bracketed population established by the enumeration pass: JPG folders 012, 013 and 014, being 552, 467 and 445 pages respectively, 1464 pages in total.
population.why_these_three: They are the folders required to bracket the sealed date window on both sides, per the sealed stopping rule.

run_boundary_rule.definition: An observing run begins at a HEADER_PAGE, being a page whose top strip carries the DECLINATION SETTING and DATE line, and continues through all following pages until the page before the next HEADER_PAGE, or the end of the folder.
run_boundary_rule.class_detection_method: Keyword presence in the MASK_V1b rectangle 300,55,1100,180, detected by OCR and confirmed visually where the OCR result is not decisive. Keyword DECLINATION indicates HEADER_PAGE; CHANNEL NUMBER indicates DATA_PAGE; JOB or PAGE with drive fields indicates JOB_LISTING_PAGE.
run_boundary_rule.candidate_locator: Page file size below 80 percent of the folder median, taken from the published directory listing. A header page has a mostly blank body and therefore less ink and a smaller JPEG, so the locator has a physical basis, but it remains a LOCATOR and not a proof of completeness.
run_boundary_rule.recall_test_declared_in_advance: A random sample of pages ABOVE the size threshold will be classified by the same method. If any of them proves to be a HEADER_PAGE, the locator is declared insufficient and the run inventory is marked INCOMPLETE. Sample size 24, drawn 8 per folder by a fixed pseudorandom seed, selected before any of those pages is viewed.

within_run_constancy_test.what_is_tested: Whether the printed per-row DECLIN. (1950.0) value is constant across the pages of a run, so that a single run-level value is a tested representation rather than an assumption.
within_run_constancy_test.sampling_rule: Three DATA_PAGEs per run, chosen structurally and not by content: the FIRST data page of the run, the MIDDLE data page by page index, and the LAST data page of the run. If a run contains fewer than three data pages, all of its data pages are sampled.
within_run_constancy_test.what_is_read: Rectangle R2 only, cropped tightly to the declination field at x 1228 to 1332 as established from the ink-density column profile, and limited to a small number of consecutive rows per sample.
within_run_constancy_test.pass_criterion: The run is RUN_LEVEL_REPRESENTATION_VALIDATED only if all sampled pages of that run show the same printed declination value in degrees and arcminutes.
within_run_constancy_test.fail_criterion: If any sampled page differs, or if any sample is illegible or ambiguous, the run is marked ROW_LEVEL_REQUIRED and its declination is NOT extrapolated.
within_run_constancy_test.no_post_hoc_adjustment: The sampling positions are fixed by this rule. A page may not be swapped for another because its value is inconvenient, and a fourth sample may not be added to break a disagreement.

transform_and_comparison.transform: The already established WOW v1 tool 042_wow/scripts/wow2_epoch.py, unmodified, FK4(equinox=B1950, obstime=B1950) to FK5(equinox=J2000).
transform_and_comparison.who_runs_it: The owner, from venv_v2. The analyst has no astropy and refuses to reimplement the transform.
transform_and_comparison.comparison: The converted J2000 declination is compared mechanically against the sealed B1 window of -27d 17m to -26d 37m.

prohibitions_during_phase_a: No frequency, channel, intensity or signal value is inspected.
No page is selected, skipped or resampled because of its apparent content.
Enumeration does not stop at the first eligible run.
The header DECLINATION SETTING is recorded but never used to decide eligibility, because the sealed B4 names the printed per-row value.
